_note: Every animal's own attack style (scripts/battle/battle_styles.gd; how it looks: battle_field.gd and fx/style_look.gd). line: what holding its card shows (8 words or fewer). kind: which style. The rest are its numbers: times in seconds, distances in tiles, pct in percent (of its bite, or of the damage it takes). The Mythics' upgrades: the Yeti's pound leaves a frost patch (frost_radius, for frost_seconds) where enemies move frost_slow_pct and attack frost_attack_pct slower, and a pound on an enemy still in frost freezes it for freeze_seconds; each knockout by Cerberus's bites stores a fire charge (fire_most at most), and its next attack spends one breathing a cone of fire (fire_tiles long, fire_cone degrees wide) that burns everyone in it for fire_seconds at fire_dps_pct of its bite a second; the Unicorn's beam heals every teammate it passes through by heal_pct of its bite; an enemy that touches the Dragon's burning line panics for scare_seconds (runs out of it on fire, burning as it runs, and can't attack; once per run; the fearless Honey Badger stands firm); the Kraken squirts ink where it dragged its enemies (ink_radius, for ink_seconds): enemy Ranged and Air in it, or shooting into it, can't hit.

brown_bear.line: Big swipes hit two at once.

snapping_turtle.line: Hides in its shell when hurt.

giant_panda.line: Sits down for a bamboo snack heal.

hippopotamus.line: Thick hide bites back at attackers.

asian_elephant.line: Shields the friends right behind it.

black_rhino.line: Charges through the enemy line first.

yeti.line: Pound leaves frost; a second pound freezes.

wild_boar.line: Charges a Tank. Huge first hit.

wolf_pack.line: Pack bites harder on the same target.

lion.line: Pride leader: nearby Tank Destroyers hit faster.

honey_badger.line: Fearless: always picks the biggest enemy.

tiger.line: Circles the flank, pounces from the side.

komodo_dragon.line: Venom bite keeps hurting; moves to the next.

cerberus.line: Each knockout: its next bite breathes fire.

gray_squirrel.line: Rapid fire: lots of little pinecones.

striped_skunk.line: Stink spray hits a whole group.

raccoon.line: Lobs trash over the line at the back.

king_cobra.line: Sniper: shoots farthest, from the very back.

sumatran_orangutan.line: Bouncing fruit hits up to three.

unicorn.line: Rainbow beam pierces foes and heals friends.

peregrine_falcon.line: Super-fast dives, then climbs back up.

barn_owl.line: Silent hunter: picks off enemy Ranged.

harpy_eagle.line: Grabs a small enemy and drops it far.

hyacinth_macaw.line: Cracks armor: its target takes extra damage.

california_condor.line: Grows stronger with every nearby fall.

dragon.line: Fire runs leave flames that scatter foes.

red_fox.line: Pops up behind, hits Ranged, digs again.

sunda_pangolin.line: Flips a Tank, then rolls into a ball.

harbor_seal.line: Belly-slides through a line, splashing all.

kraken.line: Slams drag foes in, then ink blinds them.

electric_eel.line: Lightning chains through four, stunning them.

red_panda.line: Stands tall: everyone near slows down.

pygmy_three_toed_sloth.line: Slow-motion zone: everything crawls, even shots.
